original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚卡诺州森林猎人击毙两名疑似匪徒，追回1000万奈拉赎金
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据称，在尼日利亚卡诺州多加瓦地方政府区的法尔戈雷森林，猎人伏击并击毙了两名疑似匪徒，追回1000万奈拉赎金。这笔钱据称是为换取一名于2026年9月11日被绑架、后获释的45岁男子而支付的。另有一名嫌疑人受伤逃脱，卡诺州警察司令部据报已下令搜捕。上述信息目前仅来自单一来源的报道。

location.raw_text: Falgore Forest, Doguwa Local Government Area of Kano State

key_facts.fact: 猎人据称在卡诺州法尔戈雷森林击毙两名疑似匪徒
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Hunters have reportedly killed two suspected bandits and recovered N10 million in ransom money in Falgore Forest, Doguwa Local Government Area of Kano State.
recovered N10 million in ransom money

key_facts.fact: 这笔钱据称是为换取一名于2026年9月11日被绑架、后获释的45岁男子而支付
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the recovered money was allegedly paid to secure the release of Kabiru Aliyu, 45, who was abducted on September 11, 2026, and later released unharmed

key_facts.fact: 另一名嫌疑人受伤逃脱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: One other suspect was said to have escaped with injuries.

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州警察司令部据报下令搜查法尔戈雷森林及周边社区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Kano State Police Command reportedly ordered a search of Falgore Forest and surrounding communities

uncertainties: 事件细节均来自单一来源的报道，尚未获得交叉验证
击毙、追回赎金及赎金支付等情节均为据称/被指，尚未证实
逃脱嫌疑人是否被捕尚不明确
